# Transmission as inheritance with a bounded need

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Transmission is inheritance with the need within a bound, a law of how dependence forms at coming to stand. Under balance descent forms no new dependence, and the evolution laws need it only at the descent they use, and there only from some supported giver.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

At one descent, transmission is exactly inheritance, a dependence on c that the descendant holds at its first standing step held by the giver at the giving step (Web.InheritsAt), together with the need within δ where both hold (Web.NeedsWithinAt) (Web.transmits_at_iff); for the flow, TransmitsWithin is exactly Inherits with NeedsWithin (Flow.transmitsWithin_iff). Inheritance covers a dependence forming at the descendant across the step and one it held through the step while it stood at nothing (Web.InheritsAt.split); where the descendant held no dependence on c at the giving step, inheritance is exactly the law of forming, a dependence forming at a relatum as it comes to stand being one its giver held (Web.inheritsAt_iff_forming), and transmission is that law with the need within δ (Flow.transmitsWithin_iff_forming). In general forming and holding make inheritance where the earlier holding is decided (Web.inheritsAt_of_split, Flow.transmitsWithin_iff_split), and without that only irrefutably (Web.inheritsAt_not_not); asked of every descent, that they make it is excluded middle (split_iff_em). With balance at a relatum coming to stand, it descends from something taking part in the step (Flow.descends_of_comes); under inheritance each dependence it holds after the step was held by something giving to it (Flow.inherited_from_giver, Flow.Inherits.from_giver, Flow.forms_from_giver), and where nothing taking part depends on c, nothing coming to stand depends on c after the step (Flow.no_new_dependence): transmission lets descent vary a need, never which conditions are depended on. The two bounds of evolution-on-descent (transmitted_supported, transmitted_within) hold at one descent from inheritance and the need within δ there (Flow.inherited_supported_at, Flow.inherited_within_at; for the flow Flow.inherited_supported, Flow.inherited_within); at a relatum coming to stand they need only that some supported giver held the dependence within δ (Flow.TransmitsFromSome, Flow.fromSome_supported, Flow.fromSome_within), which transmission gives under balance (Flow.TransmitsWithin.fromSome) and which is strictly weaker: a child given its standing by two givers, one depending on the pool and one not, depends on the pool; the flow balances, only active relata give, activity needs support, the law holds and transmission fails for every δ (TwoGivers.twofold). Without transmission, a descendant supported at its first standing step bounds its own need (Flow.descendant_supported_at, Flow.embodied_descendant); transmission carries the bound to a descendant not supported as it comes to stand and moves it to the giving step (Drawdown.carried). No axiom.

Canonical source: [Transmission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Transmission.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The equivalence of inheritance with forming needs that the descendant held no dependence on c at the giving step (bare); the general split needs that holding decided, and asked of every descent it is excluded middle.
- No new dependence and descent from a participant need balance at the relatum coming to stand; the evolution bounds need only active relata giving (Acting) and activity needing support (Dependent), as in evolution-on-descent.
- TwoGivers and Drawdown.carried are witnesses, each stated on one given small world.

P84 (work board), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026, answering the chapter's §8 further proof ‘deriving transmission from how dependence forms (TransmitsWithin is now a premise)’ and the next_delta of evolution-on-descent. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): transmission is not an extra assumption about the whole but a law of how dependence forms at one descent; it lets descent vary a need without adding what is depended on, so young coming to depend on their parents through descent is outside it, a matter of correspondence. On Ren's delegation the world's Transmitting (every giver) is not weakened to TransmitsFromSome (some supported giver), which is stated as the weaker law where it binds (D31). See the integration document §105.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 64 theorems of Becoming.Transmission all have empty axiom reports, among them Web.InheritsAt, Web.NeedsWithinAt, Web.transmits_at_iff, Web.InheritsAt.split, Web.inheritsAt_iff_forming, Web.inheritsAt_of_split, Web.inheritsAt_not_not, split_iff_em, Flow.Inherits, Flow.NeedsWithin, Flow.transmitsWithin_iff, Flow.transmitsWithin_iff_forming, Flow.transmitsWithin_iff_split, Flow.descends_of_comes, Flow.no_new_dependence, Flow.inherited_supported_at, Flow.inherited_within_at, Flow.TransmitsFromSome, Flow.fromSome_supported, Flow.TransmitsWithin.fromSome, TwoGivers.twofold and Drawdown.carried. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §105 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the need bound δ is a coarse bound on levels, needs are free numbers, and no reading ties them to the amounts taken and given; the law of forming is exactly inheritance only where the descendant held no dependence before, while in the core's witnesses (Drawdown, Slack, hatch) the descendant's dependence is held before it stands; no census law is stated; dependences formed newly by descent (young depending on their parents) are outside transmission; the names are the AI's wording, adopted under Ren's naming rule (InheritsAt, NeedsWithinAt, TransmitsFromSome and others).

- TwoGivers: the some-giver form holds while transmission fails for every δ. [Transmission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Transmission.lean)
